references.text: The first census that Moses and Aaron conducted in the wilderness of Sinai, as referenced in Numbers 26:64.
The Lord's judgment on the first generation that was mustered, that they should die in the wilderness and not enter the promised land.
God's declaration that the entire wicked congregation that had conspired against him would perish in the wilderness.
The continuation explaining that only Caleb and Joshua survived from the first census.
Confirmation that the entire generation of fighting men who were mustered died out, just as the Lord had sworn.
Paul refers to how God was not pleased with most of the Israelites who died in the wilderness, serving as a warning to believers.
The letter to the Hebrews refers to those who sinned and whose bodies fell in the wilderness, those who were not allowed to enter because of unbelief.
